notes.title: Smipat and the Lost Bones Playtest
notes.content:
Yesterday a small patch went live for the playtest.

Changes:
The newest patch has minor changes to current content. There is also some work done to new content, which is not testable yet (cave level). You can find the changes below:

Major Changes:
Line of Sight mechanic added to some enemies
Cave added (in gamefiles, not testable yet)
- Cave tilemap added
- Hole tiles with falling mechanic added, player can dash over a hole tile
- Water tiles added
- Bombable wall added
- Ghost enemy added
- Rock-slime enemy added (can only be damaged by bomb)
- Human miner enemy added
- Patrol enemy/object added

Minor Changes:
- Crow enemy behaviour changed
- Added sinewave behaviour to some projectiles
- Some audio effects added

Bug Fixes:
- Pushable/pullable barrels now work correctly and only one barrel at the time can be moved by the player 

Teaser screenshots of the new content:

notes.title: Smipat and the Lost Bones Playtest invitation
notes.content:
Introduction
It has been over 10 weeks since we started this project and we have come a long way since then. Today we will invite people for the playtest via the steam playtest signup system. You might get an invite and will be able to play the current state of the game. If you did not get invited, join our discord and get a direct playtest key. 

Discord: https://discord.gg/8jXNQM3uMC

Note: for the people that played the game in the past, it is recommended to reset the progress so you wont get save file related bugs. Resetting can be done in the top right corner of the main menu.

Changes
Since last time there were some changes. You can find the changes below: 

Major changes

 Bonehammer added
 7 Achievements
 Minimap
 Graveyard added 
 Dungeon added
 Dash added
 2 new auidio themes
 CROWS


Minor changes

 Bag of Bones collect animation
 Game canvas updated
 Enemies spawn event
 Signs
 Item Inventory updated
 Main menu updated
 Camara Event
 Audio Events
 Bonehammer breakables
 Bonehammer button


Bug Fixes

 Options fixed
 Item sprite flip fixed
 Feedback and bug system in-game work now
 The action buttons in the top right corner fixed


Known bugs

 Barrels
 Bone main attack won't reset
 Attacking when pausing or opening the inventory
 Audio is not fully 0 when set to 0
 Wrong floorsprites
 Swapping audio sounds bad
